name: Motor starts-per-hour restraint
summary: Limits new starts according to the documented operating-duty rule.
description: Limits new starts according to the documented operating-duty rule. A motor feeder combines switching, motor protection and an operating command. Starting permission, running feedback and protection trip are different signals even where one relay or controller processes all of them.

In a switchroom motor-control panel, a ventilation motor can receive an automatic start request while a local selector and the motor protection determine whether the feeder is available. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Start history and time” at the input and “Start restraint state” at the output. Manufacturer limits determine acceptable starting duty.
